facts.locator: Current Miyako Airport bus page explicitly identifies Miyako Kyoei. The current-linked bus access diagram and June 20 2025 terminal floor plan were visually reviewed: a continuous public first-floor arrival/central lobby and exterior sidewalk connects the bus frontage beside the arrival exit. Bind exact licensed S1754 Miyako Airport with blank platform to the whole C28 airport facility. S1860 airport entrance is a distinct stop and supplies no terminal transfer. No proximity-only link, platform invention, time or accessibility guarantee.

Independently inspected exact JTA NU551 record explicitly names Japan Transocean Air and OKA-MMY with no date restriction or operator override in remarks. Miyako Airport independently lists the same directional service. Retain minimal actual passenger topology, not timetable clocks, calendar payload, real-time availability or code-share expansion. MMY / Miyako, historically labelled Hirara in the Naha English field, is independently bound to the current Japanese Miyako Airport terminal and exact C28 facility. Both directions are separately observed.
